example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর মুখ না শামুক, সবসময় অশ্লীল কথা বলে।
বাজারে গিয়ে মুখ না শামুক লোকের সঙ্গে কথা বলিস না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a mouth that's not a clam; he always speaks vulgarly.
Don't talk to that foul-mouthed person in the market.
note: The idiom implies a mouth that is not silent like a clam but instead utters indecent words, reflecting everyday Bengali colloquialism.
